visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand with trimmed fingernails holds a small grey electronic device whose screen shows a zoomed-in photo of a silver-toned screw against a dark background. The scene is shot from a high angle over a white, slightly reflective surface in a bright room with even studio lighting. (2) The camera zooms in tightly on a tiny, real screw resting on the white surface, revealing its microscopic threads and metallic texture. The character's fingertip enters the frame to provide a scale comparison, highlighting the extreme smallness of the object under bright, even lighting. (3) The camera pans horizontally to reveal a large, well-lit industrial facility. Multiple high-precision CNC machines with displays and status lights are lined up in rows. In the background, workers in grey or brown uniforms are visible moving between the specialized equipment. The setting is modern, clean, and professional. (4) A man with a short goatee and dark beard, wearing a blue cap and a brown work jacket, holds the camera in a selfie position. He is framed in a close-up, talking animatedly with expressive facial movements. The background shows the high-ceiling factory interior with bright overhead lights.
